tests.name: zh_CN.controller.description
tests.detail: [Machine Type: §e共振燃料发电塔§r, 每批运行5秒；1并行消耗1000mB燃料，默认1并行, 中轴周围需要1648个同等级线圈, 最大并行=floor(4^((线圈热量-901)/900-1))；按实数计算, 实际并行取燃料整桶数、设定上限及线圈上限中的最小值, 塔高129格；主机可放置于世界高度Y=2~129, 每1000mB燃料同时消耗1mB科技基液和1mB魔法基液, 燃料效率=科技底数^科技指数 × 魔法底数^魔法指数, 主机右下角放入指数核心，Mk1~Mk5逐级永久升级, 仅读取第一种非底数流体；不支持时不会尝试后续燃料, 均匀输出功率；动力仓满或输出不足时，多余能量直接损失, 对主机按R或U查看发电配方；对燃料按U查看发电用途, 支持无线输出至主机所有者的无线电网, §7§m-----------------------------------------, Hold §l[LSHIFT]§r§7 to display structure guidelines]

tests.name: en_US.controller.description
tests.detail: [Machine Type: §eResonance Fuel Generator§r, Each batch lasts 5 s; 1 parallel burns 1000 mB fuel; default: 1 parallel, Requires 1648 heating coils of the same tier around the central axis, Max parallel = floor(4^((coil heat - 901)/900 - 1)); real division, Actual parallel is limited by whole fuel buckets, setting and coils, Tower height: 129; place the controller at world Y=2..129, Each 1000 mB fuel also consumes 1 mB technology base and 1 mB magic base, Fuel efficiency = technology base^exponent x magic base^exponent, Insert exponent cores in the controller slot; upgrade Mk1 to Mk5 in order, Only checks the first non-base fluid; no fallback to another fuel, Outputs power evenly; energy exceeding dynamo capacity is lost, Press R or U on the controller, or U on fuel, to view generation recipes, Supports wireless output to the controller owner's energy network, §7§m-----------------------------------------, Hold §l[LSHIFT]§r§7 to display structure guidelines]
